title: Headless TTW Rescue from Paradise (MQ07): from Mayor MacCready's request at Little Lamplight's gate to the kids bought from Eulogy Jones and thanking the player outside Paradise Falls (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Joins Picking Up the Trail (MQ06) at stage 40: Rothchild has sent the player to Little Lamplight (the MQ06 chain's way there). The 2000 caps Eulogy Jones asks for the three kids are given (a stand-in for caps earned on the way); the other ways (Squirrel's escape plan, the fight) are not this chain's.
Travel stand-in: to Little Lamplight's gate, where Mayor MacCready stops the player.

In the same conversation: after his greeting MacCready already offers "Can I come in?" (LLMacCreadyCanIComeIn) [observed, batch 2026-11-16]. Ended and begun again, he had gone behind Little Lamplight's gate, which lets only the kids' faction through (its OnActivate, SCPT 0x0006823A [observed]), and the player could not reach him.
Travel stand-in: to Paradise Falls (MQ07's script [observed] sets 15 once the player is in its worldspace) and in to Eulogy Jones.

To Paradise Falls' main entrance (its marker in the worldspace), not the front cell's middle: no navmesh lies within reach of that point, and the way the bot found instead went in by the sewer grate 0x0A034A35, which refused the player [observed, batch 2026-11-16].

At stage 90 MQ07's script [observed] unlocks the kids' pen while the player is in Paradise Falls (outside it, it puts the kids at their stage-90 marks) and takes their slave collars; the player walks to Sammy.

Stand-in for the walk away from Paradise Falls with the kids following (follower AI): the player goes to Little Lamplight's map marker and Sammy is moved to the player; out of ParadiseFallsZone, Sammy's stage-90 greeting thanks the player and sets stage 200.
